QUESTION OF THE WEEK - Ahead of next week's RBA Board meeting, the first since the July 31 rate cut, Reuters conducted its monthly interest rate poll. Full results are detailed seperately, but briefly a rate change was not expected in September, although a few economists said there was a small chance. Most economists see the most likely next move in official rates as being another cut in the fourth quarter, with November the favoured month.

RETAIL TRADE - Retail trade was seen recording a small gain in July in line with a flattening trend in recent months and only modest employment growth. Cuts in mortgage interest rates that month might have helped sentiment but borrowers' bills would not have reflected the easing for a month or so. Consumers might also have been intimidated by growing negative press speculation ahead of the August budget.
